description: Images: cid: resolution and placeholders (sec. 6.1-6.2), external images, other schemes, alt text. render(text, media, profile) vectors (docs/spec/lfm-1.md). input: {text | gen, media?, profile?, encoding_error?}; gen = prefix + repeat*times + suffix. expected holds only the asserted Rendered fields (html, styled, text, excerpt, toc, word_count, read_minutes, links, mentions, media_used, anchors, flags, error) plus derived fields: html_temml (Temml-mode HTML, sec. 7.5), text_x (P_x, sec. 10.3), html_head/html_tail (first/last 400 chars of html), html_rle (html lines, runs of identical lines as 'line ×N'), html_bytes (UTF-8 length of html). Every render vector is also checked against the sec. 13 invariants (allowlist, idempotence, sanitiser equality, terminal escapes). Inputs generated by lfm1/gen_inputs.py; expected values blessed with LESSDUGIN_BLESS=1 and reviewed.
